name: cormac
description: Cormac: a contract-first CRM agent platform, by Serenica Digital. v2 rebuild; v0 lives under archive/.

scripts.db:push:managed: infisical run --env=staging -- sh -c 'test -n "$SUPABASE_DB_URL" || { echo "SUPABASE_DB_URL missing from Infisical staging" >&2; exit 1; }; pnpm exec supabase db push --db-url "$SUPABASE_DB_URL"'
scripts.mint:agent-token: sh -c 'infisical run --env="${INFISICAL_ENV:-dev}" -- pnpm exec tsx scripts/mint-agent-token.ts "$@"' --
scripts.seed:authoring-e2e: sh -c 'infisical run --env="${INFISICAL_ENV:-dev}" -- pnpm exec tsx scripts/seed-authoring-e2e.ts "$@"' --
scripts.seed:ops-e2e: sh -c 'infisical run --env="${INFISICAL_ENV:-dev}" -- pnpm exec tsx scripts/seed-ops-e2e.ts "$@"' --
scripts.ops:batch: sh -c 'infisical run --env=dev -- pnpm exec tsx evals/ops-capture/scripts/run-batch.ts "$@"' --
